scripts.dev: pnpm run build && dotenv --no-expand -- pnpm run start
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @dfragon/lib --filter @dfragon/database --filter @dfragon/http-server build && node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.test: pnpm run build && node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('.test-dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test ".test-dist/test/**/*.test.js"
